header: This is the page of all the utility services (typed "utility services", "utilities", "all utilities"): every helper of the app beside its main search as a card, A to Z, in the look of the list of calculators. A card opens its service: a calculator or reader on its page (with a Back arrow to this page), a live card (prices, news, weather, trains, the guides) in place (also with Back). Two filters: calculators & readers, information & guides. The cards come from the registry (serviceCards.ts); I keep this file free of topic names. Nothing is sent anywhere by it.

symbols.name: UtilityServicesPage
symbols.sig: export function UtilityServicesPage({ onClose, onOpen }: { onClose: () => void; onOpen: (card: ServiceCard) => void })

behaviours: every topic that has a page or a live card is a card, and nothing else is
there are more than twenty cards
the cards stand A to Z by title
the page draws them in that order
every card has a title, a sentence, an icon, a tone and the words that open it
a calculator or reader is in the group of calculators and readers, a live card in information and guides
both groups have cards
a calculator's card says what its tile in the list of calculators says (the two lists agree)
the words shown on every card are understood by the search bar (a live card opens a live card; a calculator opens its page or answers as you type)
a card shows a short sample, never a long sentence
the words on a card are the first sample of 5 to 24 characters, else the first
the page is called Utility Services and says how many there are
three filters: all, calculators and readers, information and guides, with their counts
every card names the words that open it
a card is a button (the keyboard works)
the page has a Back button (top right, with the arrow) that returns to the search, and no cross; its tip still points to the calculators list
no privacy notice about typing (there is nothing to type into here)
'utility services' and its short forms open the page, 'calculators' still opens the list of calculators
an ordinary search that merely contains the word is not taken for it
typed, it shows 'Press Enter to open all the utility services'
opened, the panel draws the page
a calculator page opened from the page goes back to it (the Back arrow says so), and one opened from the list of calculators goes back to that
a live card opened in place has its own Back arrow to the page and closes with the page
the search window's Enter key opens it
the Utility Services tab of the guide tells the reader about the page
